description: Governor's Office - North Central Province - Vacancy in the Posts of Chairman of the Horowpotana and Kahatagasdigiliya Pradeshiya Sabhas in North Central Province and Activation of Power and Function to the Deputy Chairmans
categorisation: This gazette content deals with electoral processes at the local government level, specifically addressing the resignation and vacancy of Pradeshiya Sabha (local council) chairman positions due to budget approval failures, which are electoral and local government administrative matters. It involves the Governor's orders regarding these vacancies and the temporary transfer of powers, which falls under election-related governance rather than central government personnel or structural changes.
